transfer_noVault: There is no Kemlock vault in this browser yet. Set it up from the toolbar button first.
transfer_unlock_body: Kemlock is locked. Enter your password to import or export.
transfer_settings_body: Bring codes and logins in from another app, or take a copy out. It opens in a tab, because the toolbar popup closes when you pick a file.
transfer_import_body: Choose a Kemlock export, a backup from another authenticator or password manager, or pictures of QR codes. Nothing is saved until you have seen what it holds.
transfer_import_drop: Drop a file or pictures here, or choose them.
transfer_import_paste: You can also paste a screenshot of a QR code into this page.
transfer_import_formats: Kemlock reads its own exports (encrypted or not, with a .zip of attached files too), Aegis, 2FAS and Bitwarden backups, CSV files of logins from other password managers, Credential Exchange files, and lists of otpauth:// links.
transfer_import_google: Moving from Google Authenticator? Use its Transfer accounts › Export option, take a screenshot of the QR code it shows, and paste it here.
transfer_unread_images_one: {count} picture held no QR code Kemlock could read.
transfer_unread_images_other: {count} pictures held no QR code Kemlock could read.
transfer_password_body: {format}: enter the password it was exported with.
transfer_kit_title: Open it with a Recovery Kit
transfer_kit_body: If this file was exported from a vault that has a Recovery Kit, two of the kit’s three pieces open it without the file’s password. The pieces are used here and not kept.
transfer_review_table: What the file holds, what is new, and what the vault holds already
transfer_review_plainNote: This file is not encrypted, so it can be read as it is.
transfer_review_nothingNew: The vault holds all of this already, so there is nothing to add.
transfer_units_body: This file holds more than one place. Everything you leave ticked goes into this browser’s vault; a place you untick is left out. Kemlock for browsers has no shared spaces yet, so a place that was shared comes in as your own.
transfer_units_shared: · shared with others in the other app
transfer_mode_replaceWarning: Replacing puts the codes of this file in place of the codes in the vault. A code that is not in the file leaves the vault, and sync removes it from your other devices too.
transfer_mode_understood: I understand that codes not in the file will be removed
transfer_contacts_keepChecks: Keep the checks this file records
transfer_contacts_keepChecksDetail: The file says the keys marked above were compared with their owners. Off, every key comes in not checked, for you to compare again. Turn it on only for a backup you made yourself: anyone can write a file that says a key was checked.
transfer_skipped_one: {count} entry was left out because Kemlock does not support its type, algorithm or code length.
transfer_skipped_other: {count} entries were left out because Kemlock does not support their type, algorithm or code length.
transfer_skip_file: files do not come across in this kind of transfer; export it from the other app by hand
transfer_skip_wifi: Kemlock does not keep Wi-Fi networks
transfer_skip_apiKey: Kemlock does not keep API keys
transfer_skip_generatedPassword: Kemlock does not keep generated passwords on their own
transfer_skip_itemReference: Kemlock does not keep links between items
transfer_skip_unknownType: a kind of item Kemlock does not have
transfer_skip_unreadable: a part it needs is missing or cannot be read
transfer_skip_totpDigits: a code length Kemlock cannot generate
transfer_skip_passkeyAlgorithm: a passkey type Kemlock cannot use yet
transfer_skip_passkeyKey: the passkey’s key is too large or cannot be read
transfer_skip_sshKey: an SSH key Kemlock cannot read or keep
transfer_skip_nothingKept: nothing in it that Kemlock keeps
transfer_notice_passkeyExtras: {title}: imported without its extra secrets (PRF and blobs), which Kemlock does not serve. Sites that used them may ask you to set the passkey up again.
transfer_cut_items_one: {count} item was left out because an import holds at most 10,000 items.
transfer_cut_items_other: {count} items were left out because an import holds at most 10,000 items.
transfer_cut_credentials_one: {count} credential was left out because an item holds at most 32.
transfer_cut_credentials_other: {count} credentials were left out because an item holds at most 32.
transfer_cut_urls_one: {count} website was left out because an item holds at most 64.
transfer_cut_urls_other: {count} websites were left out because an item holds at most 64.
transfer_cut_collections_one: {count} collection is nested deeper than 8 levels and gives no tag.
transfer_cut_collections_other: {count} collections are nested deeper than 8 levels and give no tag.
transfer_cut_values_one: {count} value over 4,096 characters was left out.
transfer_cut_values_other: {count} values over 4,096 characters were left out.
transfer_attached_one: {count} attached file is named by the notes. This browser does not keep attached files, so the note comes in without it; the file stays on your phone.
transfer_attached_other: {count} attached files are named by the notes. This browser does not keep attached files, so the notes come in without them; the files stay on your phone.
transfer_review_spaces_one: {count} item comes from a shared space. This browser has no shared spaces yet, so it comes in as your own.
transfer_review_spaces_other: {count} items come from shared spaces. This browser has no shared spaces yet, so they come in as your own.
transfer_archive_one: The archive holds {count} attached file, which this browser does not keep.
transfer_archive_other: The archive holds {count} attached files, which this browser does not keep.
transfer_done_title: Imported. It is in the vault now.
transfer_done_replaced: Imported. The codes of the file replaced the codes of the vault.
transfer_done_skipped_one: {count} item was left as it is: it is in a space you can only read.
transfer_done_skipped_other: {count} items were left as they are: they are in a space you can only read.
transfer_done_sync: If this browser syncs, sync carries what you imported to your other devices shortly.
transfer_export_body: Take a copy of the vault out of this browser. Every export asks for your Kemlock password again.
transfer_export_spaces_one: {count} item of a shared space stays out of every export: its space may not allow exporting it. It stays on your phone.
transfer_export_spaces_other: {count} items of shared spaces stay out of every export: their spaces may not allow exporting them. They stay on your phone.
transfer_export_attached_one: {count} attached file is not in any export: this browser does not keep attached files. Export from your phone to take them too.
transfer_export_attached_other: {count} attached files are not in any export: this browser does not keep attached files. Export from your phone to take them too.
transfer_export_encrypted_body: A file protected by a password of its own. The Kemlock app on your phone imports it.
transfer_export_plain_body: The same file without encryption: every secret readable by anyone who holds it.
transfer_export_plain_warning: Plain exports are not encrypted. Anyone who obtains this file can read your codes’ secrets, your passwords, your notes and your private keys. Use the encrypted export for a backup.
transfer_export_csv_body: Logins and notes in the layout most password managers read.
transfer_export_csv_warning: A CSV file is not encrypted. Anyone who obtains it can read every password in it, which are written exactly as they are. In the other cells, a start of =, +, - or @ gets a ' before it, so that a spreadsheet does not run it. Delete the file as soon as the other app has read it.
transfer_export_csvNote: Each login’s code goes with it when it is a time-based one. Codes with no login, passkeys, cards and keys are not in a CSV.
transfer_export_links_body: A text file with one otpauth:// link per code, which any authenticator reads.
transfer_export_links_warning: A list of links is not encrypted. Anyone who obtains it can generate your codes. Delete it as soon as the other app has read it.
transfer_export_cxf_body: The open format password managers use to move items between them.
transfer_export_cxf_warning: What you export leaves Kemlock readable by whoever opens the file: passwords, codes, the private keys of passkeys and SSH keys, card numbers and notes. Open it only in an app you trust, and delete it afterwards.
transfer_export_cxfLeft_notSshKey_one: {count} key that is not an SSH key is left out.
transfer_export_cxfLeft_notSshKey_other: {count} keys that are not SSH keys are left out.
transfer_export_cxfLeft_protectedKey_one: {count} SSH key under a passphrase is left out.
transfer_export_cxfLeft_protectedKey_oth: {count} SSH keys under a passphrase are left out.
transfer_export_cxfLeft_notTotp_one: {count} code that is not time-based is left out.
transfer_export_cxfLeft_notTotp_other: {count} codes that are not time-based are left out.
transfer_export_cxfLeft_onCard_one: {count} key held on a hardware card is left out.
transfer_export_cxfLeft_onCard_other: {count} keys held on a hardware card are left out.
transfer_export_cxfLeft_algorithm_one: {count} key of a type Credential Exchange cannot name is left out.
transfer_export_cxfLeft_algorithm_other: {count} keys of a type Credential Exchange cannot name are left out.
transfer_export_left_algorithm: a type Credential Exchange cannot name
transfer_export_left_secret: its secret is not readable, so it is left out
transfer_export_qrGoogle_body: Transfer codes that Google Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS and most authenticators scan.
transfer_export_qrGoogle_warning: These QR codes are not encrypted. Anyone who sees or photographs them can generate your codes. Show them only to your own phone.
transfer_export_googleNote: These codes carry the codes alone. A Steam code, a code with a period other than 30 seconds or a code of an unusual length cannot go in this format, and is listed instead.
transfer_export_qrKemlock_body: Your codes and backup codes in QR codes protected by a password, which the Kemlock app scans.
transfer_export_qrKemlockPlain_body: The same QR codes without a password.
transfer_export_qrKemlockPlain_warning: These QR codes are not encrypted. Anyone who sees or photographs them can read your codes and backup codes. Show them only to your own phone.
transfer_export_kemlockQrNote: QR codes carry the codes and backup codes alone. You need every code to restore, and the password stored separately.
transfer_export_nothing: The vault has nothing this format can hold.
transfer_export_passwordHint: At least 8 characters, separate from your Kemlock password. You need it to open the file.
transfer_export_short: The password must be at least 8 characters.
transfer_export_understood: I understand that this is not encrypted
transfer_export_vaultPasswordHint: Every secret of the vault leaves with an export, so Kemlock asks for it again.
transfer_export_done: Exported as {name}. Keep it somewhere safe.
transfer_export_savedNote: The file was made in this page and handed to the browser’s download; Kemlock keeps no copy. If the download was blocked, save it again below.
transfer_qr_shown_one: {count} QR code. Anyone who sees this screen can scan it, so close it when your phone has read it.
transfer_qr_shown_other: {count} QR codes. Anyone who sees this screen can scan them, so close them when your phone has read them. Every code is needed.
transfer_qr_note: The codes disappear from the screen by themselves after two minutes.
transfer_qr_left_steam: a Steam code has no place in this format
transfer_qr_left_digits: it does not have 6 or 8 digits
transfer_qr_left_algorithm: its algorithm is not SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512
transfer_qr_left_tooLong: its name is too long for a QR code
transfer_error_refused: This page may not do that.
transfer_error_noVault: There is no vault in this browser.
transfer_error_unreadable: That picture could not be read.
transfer_error_fileTooLarge: That file is larger than Kemlock reads (40 MiB).
transfer_error_imagesTooLarge: Choose at most 40 pictures, 16 MiB each and 32 MiB in all.
transfer_error_oneFile: Choose one file at a time (or only pictures).
transfer_error_importNoKit: This file was exported without a Recovery Kit, so only its password opens it.
transfer_error_importKitFormat: That isn’t a Recovery Kit piece.
transfer_error_importKitChecksum: A piece has a typo: its check doesn’t match.
transfer_error_importKitOtherKit: These pieces are not of the kit this file was exported with.
transfer_error_importKitDuplicate: That is the same piece twice.
transfer_error_importKitWrong: These pieces do not open the file, or the file is damaged.
transfer_error_importUnsupported: Kemlock cannot read this. It opens its own exports, Aegis, 2FAS and Bitwarden backups, CSV files of logins, Credential Exchange files, otpauth:// links and QR codes.
transfer_error_importEmpty: This file holds nothing Kemlock keeps.
transfer_error_importBadPassword: That password does not open the file, or the file is damaged.
transfer_error_importBitwardenEncrypted: This Bitwarden export is encrypted. Export it again as “.json” without encryption, import it, then delete that file.
transfer_error_importCxfTooLarge: This file is larger than Kemlock reads (32 MiB). Nothing was read.
transfer_error_importCxfVersion: This file uses a version of Credential Exchange that this version of Kemlock cannot read.
transfer_error_importCxfMalformed: This Credential Exchange file is damaged, so nothing was read.
transfer_error_importArchive: This archive is damaged, or holds something an export does not, so it was not opened.
transfer_error_importQrMissing: Some of the QR codes are missing. Add the others and try again.
transfer_error_importCorrupt: This file is damaged, so nothing was read.
transfer_error_importTooLarge: That file is larger than Kemlock reads (40 MiB).
transfer_error_importNothing: There is nothing new to add.
transfer_error_notFound: The file is no longer open. Choose it again.
transfer_error_badPassword: That is not your Kemlock password.
transfer_error_exportTooShort: The password of the file must be at least 8 characters.
transfer_error_exportCheckFailed: The encrypted file did not open again as it should, so it was not saved. Try again.
